 About the Petrom network
 Cea mai mare retea de benzinarii din Romania, parte a grupului OMV Petrom. Peste 400 de statii la nivel national. Petrom operates 399 fuel stations across Romania.
 The lowest standard petrol price recorded in the network is 10.05 RON/litre , the average is 10.06 RON/litre and the maximum reaches 10.06 RON/litre.
 Prices are refreshed daily from official public sources (ANPC Price Monitor and the direct SOCAR feed) and may vary by location and fuel type.
 Check our pages for petrol price , diesel price , LPG price , fuel price statistics or lowest fuel prices in Romania .
 Petrom FAQ
 What is the Petrom fuel price today? 
 Today the average Petrom price in Romania is 10.06 RON/litre for standard petrol and 10.86 RON/litre for standard diesel.
 How many Petrom stations are there in Romania? 
 Petrom operates 399 active fuel stations across Romania.
 How much does standard petrol cost at Petrom? 
 Standard petrol 95 at Petrom averages 10.06 RON/litre, with a minimum of 10.05 RON/litre and a maximum of 10.06 RON/litre depending on location.
 Where can I find a Petrom station near me? 
 Use the map on this page to find all 399 Petrom stations in Romania, with addresses and current prices.
 What fuel types does Petrom sell? 
 At the Petrom stations we track we currently have prices for standard petrol 95, standard diesel, premium petrol and premium diesel. The range on offer can differ from one station to another.
